candidates.description: Stromal Cav1 expression increases primary tumor growth when co-injected with LM-4175 breast cancer cells
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 7C and Supplemental Figure 7C of Goetz et al. (2011) and described in Protocols 3 and 4 in the Registered Report (Fiering et al., 2015).

candidates.description: Stromal Cav1 expression increases metastatic burden when co-injected with LM-4175 breast cancer cells

candidates.description: Cav1WT fibroblasts contract and remodel collagen matrices more strongly than Cav1KO fibroblasts.

candidates.description: Stromal Cav1 expression increases the alignment of fibronectin fibers within primary tumors.
candidates.citation_sentence: This compares to the original study that reported a statistically significant increase in fibronectin fiber alignment when LM-4175 cells were co-injected with Cav1WT pMEFs [Mdn = 52.5%, IQR = 43.6–55.4%, n = 8] compared to LM-4175 cells [Mdn = 36.9%, IQR = 36.8–37.7%, n = 5] or LM-4175 plus Cav1KO pMEFs [Mdn = 42.2%, IQR = 40.8–43.2%, n = 10], suggesting stromal Cav1 remodels the intratumoral microenvironment (Goetz et al., 2011).
candidates.notes: The replication effect was in the predicted direction but was not statistically significant, and the image-analysis workflow differed from the original. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

This is an interpretation disagreement, not a wrong-original pairing; failure is better supported than calling it a significant reversal.
